### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We will see faster services, better policy, stronger coordination, and more capable public institutions.

2. We know what superintelligent AI will mean for government: better decisions, less waste, faster crisis response, and public services that work. Every government will become more effective.

3. Superintelligent AI will transform governing capacity everywhere. We will gain institutions that can solve complex problems, manage resources precisely, and deliver results faster. Every government will be more effective.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. It will give public institutions the power to analyze complex problems, design better policy, deliver services faster, and respond to crises with unprecedented speed and precision. From city halls to national ministries, governments will be able to reduce waste, coordinate agencies, strengthen infrastructure, and meet public needs at a scale that is impossible today. We see this as a transformation of governing capacity: better decisions, stronger execution, and more reliable results. The task before us is to prepare institutions to use that capability responsibly and ensure its benefits reach everyone.
